summary: The proof is sequentially valid. The same-index graph inclusion yields eta_j >= 0 and the exact height-shift decomposition. The midpoint multiplicity identity and row inequalities give the strict four-defect budget with every term nonnegative. The centroid halfplane argument correctly makes the Grunbaum bound strict, the complementary sets satisfy the required Brunn-Minkowski inclusion, and the shared-deletion minimization is attained at deleting from the smaller body. All positivity, boundary, and strict-constant claims, including exclusion of equality in the reverse of (14), are justified.
